g.text: Sequence — Node restart and Merkle-tree anti-entropy repair
wait until peers have acked a heartbeat
From here on every new write includes C,
so only writes made before this point can be missing.
[for each healthy peer (A shown) sharing ranges with C]
[descend only into differing subtrees (batched across ranges)]
During repair C already accepts replicated writes and serves reads.
Reads stay correct: R + W > N, so every R = 2 quorum includes
at least one up-to-date replica, and the resolver picks the newest.
